title: Steinman fired by Lockheed after his book
summary: Scott Ramsay tells of Steinman fired by Lockheed after his book, about 1986 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher of a reported UFO crash, tells a podcast about a man named Bill Steinman who worked for Lockheed, a large American aircraft company, and wrote a book about flying saucers. Ramsay says Steinman was warned that the company did not like employees writing such books, and that a couple of days after it came out in 1986, he was fired. The story is told as a sign of how much pressure there was to keep quiet on the subject.
